g.text: S-S1, near 180s; closest-to-median drift among windows with at least 100 m travel. Paths translated to start at zero.
Absolute ATE RMSE: 97.9 m. Aligned RMSE removes initial offset; neither metric is surveyed ground-truth accuracy.
